title: testRunFolders follows a cd inside a subshell past its end
notes: src/main/workflow/test-run-guard.ts:47-58: (cd packages/a && pnpm test) && pnpm test judges the second run in packages/a, but it runs in the folder the line started in. The guard can then refuse a test run because of one going in another worktree, or miss the one going in its own. removesOwnWorktree in worktree-guard.ts already counts subshell depth; move that walk into hook-answer.ts and use it in all three guards. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/350 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/349#discussion_r4679074145
